THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
WINTER
047
STUDY 072
Blush Belted Coat & Plaid Mini
Rights check
Source: 24400.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, soft light brown hair
falls past her shoulders and smiles gently. She wears a
blush-pink wool coat with a belted waist, oversized
sleeves, and a tartan plaid collar. Beneath it, a pleated
tartan mini skirt and cream cable-knit tights. Her
expression is warm and relaxed. A pale plaster
backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of blush, camel,
and cream. Sweet and layered, in the style of a winter
boutique lookbook.
Sweet, soft, layered
WORKING NOTES
- The blush coat and tartan collar create the soft contrast.
- Keep the cable-knit tights for a cozy winter layer.
Try this: Keep the cable-knit tights for a cozy winter layer.
